usedFor: Linear tracks issues, and Todoist receives them as tasks when “New Issue Created” runs “Create Task”.

bestTemplate.name: “New Issue Created” in Linear, then “Create Task” in Todoist
bestTemplate.why: Every new issue becomes a Todoist task with its title and details.

watchOut: “New Incomplete Task” in Todoist only catches tasks added within the last few minutes, so older ones are missed.
